name: PenFed Gold Visa® Card

apr.notes: 0% introductory APR for 15 months on purchases, after which a variable 17.99% APR applies based on creditworthiness and varies with the market based on the Prime Rate. 0% introductory APR for 15 months on balance transfers made in the first 60 days after account opening; after that, the APR for the unpaid balance is a standard non-variable rate of 17.99%. 3% balance transfer fee per transaction. 17.99% APR for cash advances; no cash advance fee.

credit_required.notes: Credit score of 700+ generally recommended; PenFed membership required.

base_rate.description: No rewards earned; the PenFed Gold Visa is a low-APR / balance-transfer card, not a rewards card.

benefits.title: $0 Liability on Unauthorized Charges
benefits.description: Visa Zero Liability protection means you are not responsible for unauthorized charges made with your card.

benefits.title: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Protect your cell phone against theft and damage by paying your monthly wireless bill with your PenFed credit card.

benefits.title: Travel Accident Coverage
benefits.description: When you purchase your travel ticket with your PenFed credit card, you are eligible for accident coverage of up to $250,000.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Automatic protection for physical damage, theft, reasonable and customary towing, and loss-of-use charges when renting with the card.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Use your PenFed credit card worldwide without any additional fees.

benefits.title: No Cash Advance Fee
benefits.description: No cash advance fee; cash advance APR of 17.99% applies.

notes: Visa Traditional. $0 annual fee. Low-APR / balance-transfer card with no rewards. 0% intro APR for 15 months on purchases and on balance transfers made in the first 60 days, then 17.99% (variable for purchases, non-variable for balance transfers). 3% balance transfer fee. No foreign transaction fees. No cash advance fee.
